items.description: RKQC is a compiler for reversible logic circuitry. The framework has been developed to compile high level circuit descriptions down to "QASM" format assembly language instructions, primarily for quantum computing machines.
The first multilingual x86_64 assembler. Write assembly in your native language. 10 languages, 80+ instructions, reversible translation.
code and assembly language to display 10 reversible primes
This is a program that prints out the first ten reversible prime squares. There is a C program, Assembly Language program and Machine Code program.
Program that prints the first 10 reversible prime squares. we wiil be using high level language C and low- level langauge assembly and then the machine code.

A full-spectrum natural language to quantum compiler that translates structured human requests (in standard text) into:  Quantum Assembly (QASM 2.0/3.0)  Quantum Error Correction codes (qLDPC-ready)  Trinary logic & custom gate mappings  Reversible output back into human-readable explanations
